login_required.userMessage: We couldn't access the content because it's behind a login. This is common for school platforms like Canvas, Schoology, and Google Classroom.

recovery.step1: Copy the text from the page and paste it here
recovery.step2: Export or print the page as PDF and upload it
recovery.step3: Take a screenshot of the content and upload the image

paywall.userTitle: This content is behind a paywall
paywall.userMessage: The page requires a subscription or payment to access the full content.

recovery.step1: Copy the text you can see and paste it here
recovery.step2: If you have access, export the page as PDF and upload it
recovery.step3: Take a screenshot of the content

permissions_required.userMessage: The link requires specific permissions that we don't have. This often happens with Google Drive or shared documents.

recovery.step1: Make sure the link is set to 'Anyone with the link can view'
recovery.step2: Copy the content and paste it directly here
recovery.step3: Download the file and upload it instead

quizlet_flashcards.userMessage: Quizlet blocks automated access to their flashcard content.

recovery.step1: Export your Quizlet set: click ⋮ → Export → copy the text and paste it here
recovery.step2: Take a screenshot of the flashcards and upload the image

embedded_pdf_viewer.userTitle: This page shows a document preview
embedded_pdf_viewer.userMessage: This page is showing a PDF or document in an online viewer. We can only see a preview — not the full content.

recovery.step1: Download the full PDF and upload it here instead
recovery.step2: If there's a download button on the page, use it to get the full document
recovery.step3: Copy any visible text and paste it here

embedded_presentation.userMessage: The content is in a slide presentation viewer. The text is trapped in the slide format and can't be extracted.

recovery.step1: Export the presentation as PDF and upload it here
recovery.step2: Copy the text from individual slides and paste it here
recovery.step3: Take screenshots of the slides and upload them as images

interactive_content.userTitle: This is interactive content I can't read
interactive_content.userMessage: The page contains a game, simulation, or interactive tool. We can only work with text-based content.

recovery.step1: Copy any visible text from the page and paste it here
recovery.step2: Take a screenshot of the relevant content
recovery.step3: Describe what you need help with in the text box

embedded_video.userMessage: The content is primarily in a video, which we can't extract text from this way.

recovery.step1: For YouTube videos, paste the YouTube URL directly — we handle those separately
recovery.step2: If the video has a transcript, copy and paste it here
recovery.step3: Describe the content of the video in the text box

toc_page_only.userTitle: This page is a table of contents
toc_page_only.userMessage: This page is a navigation or overview page that lists topics and sections, but doesn't contain the actual learning material.

recovery.step1: If there is a PDF or document on the page, download and upload it here
recovery.step2: Open the specific section or chapter you need and share that link instead
recovery.step3: Copy the content you need from the actual pages and paste it here

youtube_unlisted.userTitle: This YouTube video isn't publicly accessible
youtube_unlisted.userMessage: The video is private or unlisted, so we can't access it.

recovery.step1: Make the video 'Unlisted' or 'Public' in YouTube Studio settings
recovery.step2: If you have access, use YouTube's transcript feature: click ⋯ → Show transcript → copy and paste it here

page_not_found.userMessage: The URL returned a 404 error — the page doesn't exist or has been moved.

recovery.step2: Try searching for the content on the website directly
recovery.step3: Copy the content from the correct page and paste it here

dns_error.userMessage: The domain doesn't exist or isn't responding. The URL might be incorrect.

recovery.step2: Make sure this is a valid web address

connection_failed.userMessage: The website timed out or refused the connection. It might be down temporarily.

recovery.step1: Try again in a few minutes
recovery.step2: Copy the content from the page and paste it here instead

content_too_short.userTitle: I couldn't get enough content from this page
content_too_short.userMessage: We could access the page, but the extracted content was too short to be useful for tutoring.

recovery.step1: Copy the text directly from the page and paste it here
recovery.step2: Take a screenshot of the content and upload the image

extraction_failed.userMessage: We weren't able to extract the content from this URL. This can happen with some websites.

recovery.step1: Copy the text from the page and paste it here
recovery.step2: Export or print the page as PDF and upload it
recovery.step3: Take a screenshot and upload the image

local_file_link.userTitle: This is a link to a file on your computer
local_file_link.userMessage: Links starting with file:// point to files on your computer, which we can't access from the web.

recovery.step1: Drag and drop the file into Studdy instead
recovery.step2: Use the upload button (📎) to attach the file

pdf_download_failed.userMessage: The URL points to a PDF file, but we were unable to download it.

recovery.step1: Download the PDF yourself and upload it here
recovery.step2: Try opening the PDF in your browser, then print-to-PDF and upload that
